entities.name: Francisco Peralta y Ballabriga
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Francisco Peralta y Ballabriga was a Spanish Roman Catholic bishop. At the time of his death, aged 95, he was one of the oldest bishops in the Church and one of the oldest bishops in Spain.
